info.title: txapela
info.description: Pelota tournaments run by a club. Paths are under /api/v1. Organizers write with a bearer token; reads are public, and a draft tournament, with its series and teams, is seen only with the organizer token. The licence numbers and contacts of players are for the organizer only. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a stable type. Dates are civil dates YYYY-MM-DD in Europe/Paris. Every API response sends Cache-Control: private, no-store.

get.summary: Answers this document, the contract that clients generate their types from. Needs no token.

200.description: The OpenAPI 3.1 document of the API, this one

get.summary: List the tournaments, by first match date then slug. Drafts only with the organizer token.

200.description: The tournaments; drafts only for an organizer

post.summary: Create a tournament, as a draft (organizer).

get.summary:
A tournament: 404 when no tournament has this slug, or when it is a draft and the caller has
no organizer token.

delete.summary:
Delete a draft tournament with its courts, specialties, series, teams and players
(organizer).

204.description: Tournament deleted, with its courts, specialties, series, teams and players

patch.summary:
Change a tournament (organizer): a partial body, checked on the merged state with the rules of
creation. Aire, specialties, points, ranking and courts change only in draft. `status` moves
one step forward. A specialty that a series plays stays, and `max_teams` stays at least the
registered teams (422).

get.summary:
List the series of a tournament, by position then slug. The series of a draft only with the
organizer token.

post.summary: Create a series in a tournament, while it is a draft or in registration (organizer).

get.summary:
A series: 404 when the tournament has no series with this slug, or when the tournament is a
draft and the caller has no organizer token.

delete.summary:
Delete a series without teams, while the tournament is a draft or in registration
(organizer).

patch.summary:
Change a series (organizer): a partial body, checked on the merged state with the rules of
creation. Name and position change in every status; specialty, maximum and number block only
while the tournament is a draft or in registration. The block cannot move under teams, and
the maximum stays at least the registered teams.

post.summary:
Draw the pools of a series from its registered teams, in snake order of their seeds and away
from the teams of their club when the draw can, and generate their matches (organizer). The
tournament is `pools`. A series is drawn again while it has no result: the new draw replaces
the pools, their matches and their tiebreak.

get.summary:
List the matches of the pools of a series, by pool then number. The matches of a draft only
with the organizer token.

200.description: The matches of the series, empty until the draw

get.summary:
List the pools of a series with their teams, by name. The pools of a draft only with the
organizer token.

200.description: The pools of the series, empty until the draw

get.summary:
A match: 404 when the pool has no match with this number, or when the tournament is a draft
and the caller has no organizer token.

put.summary:
Record the result of a match, or record it again to correct it (organizer), while the
tournament is `pools`. A forfeit records the target score of the series to 0 for the other
team. Standings follow at once: they are computed on every read.

post.summary:
Move a team of the series into this pool (organizer), while the tournament is `pools` and
until the first result of the series. The matches of both pools are generated again, and
their tiebreak goes. A move leaves 3 to 7 teams in each pool. A team already in the pool
stays: nothing changes.

200.description: The pools of the series after the move

put.summary:
Order the teams of a pool by hand (organizer), while the tournament is `pools`: the order
separates the teams still level on points and goal average, and only them. A draw or a move
of the pool removes it.

200.description: The standings of the pools of the series with the order

get.summary:
The standings of each pool of a series, computed from its matches and the points of the
tournament. The standings of a draft only with the organizer token.

200.description: The standings of the pools of the series

get.summary:
List the teams of a tournament, by number. The teams of a draft only with the organizer
token, and licence numbers, contacts, registration dates and fees only for the organizer.

post.summary:
Register a team in a series, while the tournament is a draft or in registration
(organizer). The registration date is the day of the request in Europe/Paris.

get.summary:
A team: 404 when the tournament has no team with this number, or when the tournament is a
draft and the caller has no organizer token. Licence numbers, contacts, registration date
and fee only for the organizer.

delete.summary:
Delete a team with its players, while the tournament is a draft or in registration
(organizer).

patch.summary:
Change a team (organizer): its players and fee in every status, its status while the
tournament is a draft or in registration. A team that withdraws once the tournament is in
pools stays in its pool: the organizer records its remaining matches as forfeits.

Court.description: A named court of the venue, such as `Trinquet A`, used by the calendar.

name.description: Trimmed, not empty, unique within the tournament.

number_block.description: A multiple of 100 that no other series of the tournament has.

slug.description:
3 to 64 characters among a-z, 0-9 and single hyphens, starting and ending with a letter
or a digit, unique within the tournament. Immutable.

CreateTeam.description: `POST /tournaments/:slug/teams`. A new team is registered, on the day of the request.

number.description: In the number block of the series, unique within the tournament. Immutable.

series.description: The slug of a series of the tournament. Immutable.

CreateTournament.description: `POST /tournaments`. A new tournament is a draft.

fee_cents.description: Fee per team in euro cents, shown only.

points.description: Default: 3 for a win, 1 for a loss, 0 for a forfeit.

slug.description:
3 to 64 characters among a-z, 0-9 and single hyphens, starting and ending with a letter
or a digit. Immutable.

Dates.description:
The dates of the tournament, `YYYY-MM-DD` in Europe/Paris: registration opens <=
registration closes <= first match <= finals.

DatesChanges.description:
The dates in a `PATCH`: an absent date keeps the stored one, and the four dates must stay in
order.

pool_size.description:
The largest pool: 4, 5 or 6 teams, in as few pools as it allows. Give `pool_size` or
`pools`, not both.

pools.description: The number of pools. Every pool holds 4 to 6 teams, and pools differ by one team at most.

seeds.description:
The team numbers of the first seeds, in order: the other registered teams follow by
number.

ExtensibleProblemDocument.description:
The body of an error response whose `type` list grows: the series, teams, pools,
matches and standings routes.

ExtensibleProblemType.description: The `type` of a problem: one per error, stable across versions. The list grows: a client maps the types it knows and falls back on the status for the others.

forfeited_by.description: The number of the team that forfeited.

number.description: The public key within the pool, from 1, in the order of the rounds.

phase.description: `pool` for the matches of the pools.

round.description:
The round of the round robin, from 1. In a pool with an odd number of teams, one team
rests each round.

score.description:
Once played or forfeit: the scores of `teams`, in their order. A forfeit gives the target
score of the series to the other team and 0 to the team that forfeited.

teams.description: The two teams, the better seed first.

matches.description: By pool, then number. Empty until the draw.

MatchPhase.description: The part of the tournament a match belongs to. The list grows: a client shows the values it knows and falls back on the raw value for the others.

MatchResult.description:
`PUT /tournaments/:slug/series/:series/pools/:pool/matches/:match/result`: the two teams of
the match, and either their score or the team that forfeits.

forfeited_by.description:
The number of the team that forfeits: the other team gets the target score, and it gets
0, which counts in the goal average.

score.description:
The scores of `teams`, in their order: one team reaches exactly the target score of the
series, and the other stays below it. Give `score` or `forfeited_by`, not both.

teams.description:
The numbers of the two teams of the match, in either order: the score follows this order.
A result never lands on another pair.

MatchState.description: Where a match stands: scheduled, played, forfeit or postponed. The list grows: a client shows the values it knows and falls back on the raw value for the others.

number.description: The number of a team in another pool of the series.

Player.description:
A player. `licence` and `contact` are personal data: the organizer sends and reads them, and
public responses leave them out.

contact.description: A phone number or an email address. Organizer only: absent from public responses.

licence.description: Organizer only: absent from public responses.

Points.description: Points of a match in the pool ranking: win > loss >= forfeit >= 0.

PointsChanges.description:
Points in a request. At creation, an absent value takes its default: 3 for a win, 1 for a
loss, 0 for a forfeit. In a `PATCH`, it keeps the stored value.

name.description: The public key within the series: A, B, C… Pool A is Frontis's `pool` 1.

pools.description: By name. Empty until the draw.

standings.description: By rank, then team number among teams that share a rank.

seed.description: Its place in the seed order of the draw, from 1. It keeps it when it moves.

ProblemDocument.description: The body of an error response.

ProblemType.description: The `type` of a problem: one per error, stable across versions.

PublicPlayer.description: A player as everyone sees it: no licence and no contact, whoever calls.

max_teams.description: The most registered teams the series takes: withdrawn teams do not count.

number_block.description:
The first team number of the series: its teams are numbered from `number_block` to
`number_block` + 99, and no other series of the tournament has this block.

position.description: Display order: series are listed by position, then slug.

slug.description: The public key within the tournament, chosen at creation and immutable.

specialty.description: One of the specialties of the tournament.

target_score.description:
The score a team must reach to win a match: the target score of the specialty in the
tournament.

SeriesChanges.description:
`PATCH /tournaments/:slug/series/:series`: absent fields keep their value, and no field
takes `null`. The slug never changes. Specialty, maximum and number block change only while
the tournament is a draft or in registration.

max_teams.description: Draft or registration only. At least the registered teams of the series.

number_block.description: Draft or registration only, and only while the series has no team.

specialty.description: Draft or registration only. A specialty the tournament declares.

Specialty.description:
A specialty played in the tournament: `tournament_specialties.specialty`. The order of the
variants is the order of a tournament's specialties.

SpecialtyTarget.description: A specialty of the tournament and the score a team must reach to win a match of it.

Standing.description: The line of a team in the standings of its pool.

forfeits.description: The matches the team forfeited: each gives it the forfeit points of the tournament.

played.description: Matches with a result, played or forfeit.

rank.description:
From 1, by points then goal average. Teams still level share it, unless the organizer's
tiebreak separates them.

pools.description: By pool. Empty until the draw.

Status.description: `tournaments.status`. A new tournament is a draft.

number.description: The public key within the tournament, in the number block of its series. Immutable.

players.description: The two players, in the organizer's order.

registered_on.description:
Organizer only: the date in Europe/Paris when the organizer registered the team, set by
txapela.

series.description: The slug of its series. Immutable.

TeamChanges.description:
`PATCH /tournaments/:slug/teams/:number`: absent fields keep their value, and no field takes
`null`. The number, the series and the registration date never change.

status.description:
Draft or registration only: a withdrawn team registered again needs a place in its
series and tournament.

TeamSummary.description:
A team as the pools, matches and standings show it, to every caller: its number and the
names and clubs of its players.

teams.description:
Every team number of the pool once, in the organizer's order, or none to remove the
order. It separates only the teams level on points and goal average.

fee_cents.description: Fee per team in euro cents, shown only: payment is out of scope.

slug.description: The public key, chosen at creation and immutable.

TournamentChanges.description:
`PATCH /tournaments/:slug`: absent fields keep their value, and no field takes `null`. The
slug never changes. Aire, specialties, points, ranking and courts change only while the
tournament is a draft.

points.description: Draft only. Absent values keep the stored ones.

specialties.description: Draft only. Replaces the specialties and their target scores.

status.description: One step forward only: draft → registration → pools → finals → finished.

tournaments.description: By first match date, then slug.

VenueChanges.description: The venue in a `PATCH`: an absent value keeps the stored one.

Conflict.description: Slug taken, not a draft, or a status change other than one step forward.

NotFound.description:
No tournament with this slug, or a draft and no organizer token: both answer the same.
Under a tournament, no series or team with this key either.

PoolsConflict.description:
A draw, a move, a tiebreak or a result that the tournament or the series forbid: the
tournament is not in its pools, or the series has results.

SeriesAndTeamsConflict.description:
A series or team that conflicts with its tournament, its series or the other series and
teams: registration closed, a slug, number block or team number taken, a full series or
tournament, or a series that still has teams.

Unauthorized.description: No organizer token, a malformed or wrong one, or no secret to check it against.

Unprocessable.description:
The body is not JSON, has an unknown or `null` field, or breaks a rule: the `detail`
names it.

bearer.description: Organizer token, compared by its SHA-256 with a Worker secret. Required to write; on reads, it shows drafts too.
